'''"Cut the Phobium" ''' was a popular [[Music/Legends|tune]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era.

==Behind the scenes==
"Cut the Phobium" is background music heard in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Players can select it in [[Jukebox/Legends|jukeboxes]] using a jukebox token.
